record.body:
## Interfaces

Skill clear CLIs (kinds-and-focus / engage / discuss / plan-phase / verify-work / execute-phase) and dashboard dismiss helper share the same human-dismissible kind set and the same mutations: continuity-question → update answered; finding → update needs none; unsigned manual check → correct signed_by. Dashboard refuses loop-route / integration / merge-branch.

## Assumptions

adaptive-artifacts on PATH for the dashboard process; signer via SE_WORKFLOW_SIGNED_BY / USER. No dashboard-local dismiss cache. Parent session remains the skill writer.

## Invariants

CLI-equivalent outcomes hold after mid-wave amendment: skills no longer document illegal finding supersede. Human-dismissible kinds only. Needs you derives from store state after refresh.

## Conflicts

none (resolved: planned supersede vs runtime update for findings)
